subject: [PATCH 13/60] mm/compaction: restrict compaction to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to optimize compaction by restricting it to common memory nodes. The changes are focused on modifying the kcompactd initialization and compaction node traversal to only consider common nodes.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts compaction to common memory nodes, improving performance and reducing unnecessary work on memoryless nodes. The changes include modifying the kcompactd initialization, compaction node traversal, and proactive compaction trigger to only consider common nodes. This approach is expected to optimize resource utilization and reduce overhead.
